ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Online text-prompt tuning for Grounding DINO under weather and sensor shift
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with a Swin-T backbone at test time by updating only 8 learnable tokens appended to the category prompt, with the image and text encoders frozen. Pseudo-labels come from the detector itself, kept when confidence exceeds 0.35, and the tokens are updated after each batch of 8 images with a box-level cross-entropy and a regression term. The stream is Cityscapes foggy at three severities, followed by the BDD100K night split, one pass over each.
CONTROLS: The zero-shot detector with no adaptation, full-parameter self-training, and a variant that updates the prompt tokens with batch-statistics entropy minimization instead of pseudo-labels. Three stream orders, scored by mAP at 50 and by drift from zero-shot mAP on the COCO validation set. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Expected gain of 3 to 4 mAP points on foggy and night data with under 1 point lost on COCO. It could fail if prompt tokens overfit to the dominant class in each stream.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Prompt token adaptation of Grounding DINO on shifted driving benchmarks
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with a Swin-T backbone at test time by updating learnable tokens appended to the category prompt while the image and text encoders stay frozen. Pseudo-labels from the detector are kept above a confidence of 0.35, and the tokens are updated after each batch of 8 images. Evaluation covers nine shifted benchmarks from Cityscapes foggy, BDD100K night, ACDC rain and Sim10k, each in 4 random stream orders, with the token count taken at seven values between 4 and 64.
CONTROLS: The zero-shot detector, full-parameter self-training, and an entropy-minimization variant, with results tabulated per benchmark and per token count and a paired test on the effect of stream order. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Expected token count to matter little between 8 and 32, with 3 to 4 mAP points gained on foggy and night data. It could fail if order effects exceed gains on the easiest benchmarks.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Prototype memory for images without usable pseudo-labels in test-time detection
PROPOSAL: When confidence filtering leaves a test image with no pseudo-label, use a bank of class prototypes built online from the box features of earlier confident detections, updated by exponential moving average. The empty image is then scored against the prototypes to recover candidate boxes from the detector's low-confidence proposals, and the recovered boxes feed the same self-training loss. Grounding DINO with Swin-B is adapted on Cityscapes foggy, ACDC night and BDD100K rain in one pass.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, self-training that skips empty images, self-training that lowers the threshold until every image has a box, and prototypes with random assignment in place of similarity. Reported on mAP at 50 and on the fraction of recovered boxes that match annotations. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 480
PREDICTION: Expected 1.5 to 2 mAP points above skipping empty images, with about 70 percent of recovered boxes correct. It could fail if early prototypes are noisy and reinforce the detector's own mistakes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Prototype bank design for empty-image recovery in test-time detection
PROPOSAL: When confidence filtering leaves a test image with no pseudo-label, use a bank of class prototypes built online from earlier confident detections of Grounding DINO with Swin-B and score the empty image against them to recover candidate boxes from low-confidence proposals. The design varies the prototype count per class over seven values, the update momentum over four values and the similarity function over three kinds, each trained on Cityscapes foggy, ACDC night and BDD100K rain, and every combination reports recovered-box precision against annotations.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, self-training that skips empty images, and prototypes with random assignment, plus a table of mAP at 50 and recovery precision for all settings. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 480
PREDICTION: Expected most settings to land within 0.5 mAP points of each other and 1.5 to 2 points above skipping empty images. It could fail if recovery precision is dominated by the similarity function alone.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Low-rank adapters in the fusion layers of Grounding DINO during test time
PROPOSAL: Insert rank-4 low-rank adapters into the cross-modality fusion layers of Grounding DINO with Swin-T and update only those adapters online with pseudo-labels above a confidence of 0.4. The target is the Cityscapes foggy validation set of 500 images, processed once in batches of 4, so the adaptation itself is small and the evaluation is a single pass.
CONTROLS: Zero-shot detector, adapters placed in the image backbone instead of the fusion layers, and full-parameter self-training. Reported as mAP at 50 on foggy and by mAP on a 500 image COCO subset to track lost generalization. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 36
PREDICTION: Expected 2 to 3 mAP points on foggy with under 0.5 points lost on COCO. It could fail if fusion adapters see too few pseudo-labeled objects per batch to move.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Rank sensitivity of low-rank adapters in Grounding DINO for foggy test-time detection
PROPOSAL: Insert low-rank adapters into the cross-modality fusion layers of Grounding DINO with Swin-T and update only those adapters online with pseudo-labels above a confidence of 0.4. Six ranks from 1 to 32 are each applied at three insertion depths and 3 learning rates on the 500 image Cityscapes foggy validation set, processed in batches of 4.
CONTROLS: Zero-shot detector, adapters in the image backbone, and full-parameter self-training, with mAP at 50 on foggy and on a 500 image COCO subset reported for every rank, depth and learning rate. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 36
PREDICTION: Expected 2 to 3 mAP points on foggy at moderate ranks, flat above 8. It could fail if learning rate rather than rank explains most of the differences.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Source-free normalization updates for vision-language detectors under shift
PROPOSAL: Test whether re-estimating normalization layer statistics from the test stream, with no source data, improves Grounding DINO with Swin-B on shifted targets. Statistics of the image backbone are replaced by a running estimate over incoming batches of 16 images, and only normalization scale and shift parameters are trained with pseudo-labels above 0.35. Targets are Cityscapes foggy, BDD100K night and the Sim10k to Cityscapes car transfer, 2975 images each at most.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, running-statistics replacement without training, parameter training without replacement, and full-parameter self-training. Reported with mAP at 50 and a measure of peak memory per method. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Expected 2 to 3 mAP points over no adaptation, with the combination beating either part alone by about 1 point. It could fail if small batches make the running estimate unstable on night data.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Batch size and momentum for source-free normalization of Grounding DINO
PROPOSAL: Test whether re-estimating normalization layer statistics from the test stream, with no source data, improves Grounding DINO with Swin-B on shifted targets. Backbone statistics are replaced by a running estimate over incoming batches, and normalization scale and shift parameters are trained with pseudo-labels above 0.35. Batch sizes from 2 up to 64 are crossed with three momenta on Cityscapes foggy, BDD100K night and Sim10k to Cityscapes.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, replacement without training, training without replacement, and full-parameter self-training, with mAP at 50 and peak memory in a table for all batch sizes and momenta, split by target dataset. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 900
PREDICTION: Expected 2 to 3 mAP points over no adaptation at moderate batch sizes, with momentum mattering little. It could fail if batch size dominates every other factor, which would limit the practical lesson.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Cross-category adaptation of Grounding DINO to novel object names at test time
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with Swin-T online on a target stream whose categories partly lie outside the source label space. Prompts list both seen and novel category names, and pseudo-labels for novel names are admitted only when text-image similarity and box score both exceed their running medians. Streams are built from LVIS images of 40 rare categories and from Objects365 images of 60 categories, in a single pass of batches of 8.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, self-training restricted to seen categories, and self-training with a single fixed threshold for all names. Reported as mAP on novel and on seen categories separately. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 240
PREDICTION: Expected 2 mAP points gained on novel categories with seen categories holding within 0.5 points. It could fail if novel names with similar wording are confused and pseudo-labels reinforce the confusion.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Threshold schedule study for novel-category pseudo-labels in Grounding DINO
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with Swin-T online on a target stream whose categories partly lie outside the source label space, with prompts listing seen and novel names. Pseudo-labels for novel names are admitted by thresholds on text-image similarity and box score, each scheduled over 7 settings in a grid crossing, on streams built from LVIS images of 40 rare categories and Objects365 images of 60 categories, in batches of 8.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, self-training restricted to seen categories, and a single fixed threshold, with a map of mAP on novel and seen categories over all threshold settings. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 240
PREDICTION: Expected a ridge of good settings near moderate thresholds with 2 mAP points gained on novel categories. It could fail if the ridge shifts between the two streams.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adaptive confidence threshold selection for online pseudo-labeling in detection
PROPOSAL: Replace the fixed confidence threshold of self-training for Grounding DINO with Swin-T by a per-batch threshold set at a running quantile of box scores, so that a stable share of boxes survives. The model is adapted on the 500 image BDD100K night validation subset in batches of 4, updating the last 2 decoder layers only.
CONTROLS: Fixed thresholds of 0.3 and 0.5, a quantile threshold fixed after a warm-up period, and no adaptation. Reported as mAP at 50 and by the share of images left without any pseudo-label. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Expected 1 to 2 mAP points above the best fixed threshold with fewer than 5 percent of images left empty. It could fail if the score distribution shifts so fast that the running quantile lags.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Quantile threshold comparison for online pseudo-labeling in Grounding DINO
PROPOSAL: Replace the fixed confidence threshold of self-training for Grounding DINO with Swin-T by a per-batch threshold set at a running quantile of box scores, updating the last 2 decoder layers only. The quantile level takes 9 values and the running window 6 lengths, tried on 4 target sets from BDD100K night, Cityscapes foggy, ACDC rain and ACDC snow, in batches of 4.
CONTROLS: Fixed thresholds of 0.3 and 0.5, a quantile fixed after warm-up, and no adaptation, with mAP at 50 and share of empty images reported for each cell. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Expected 1 to 2 mAP points above the best fixed threshold, with window length mattering less than quantile level. It could fail if gains appear only on one target set.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Continual test-time adaptation of Grounding DINO over a long drifting stream
PROPOSAL: Study forgetting and error accumulation when Grounding DINO with Swin-B is adapted over a long stream that moves from Cityscapes clear to foggy, rainy, night and snowy conditions, with 40000 images in total and gradual blends between conditions. Adapters in the fusion layers are updated with pseudo-labels above 0.35, and mAP is logged every 1000 images on a fixed probe set of each condition and on COCO.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, resetting adapters when a drift detector fires, and unconstrained adaptation. Reported with mAP curves over the stream and a count of resets. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Expected unconstrained adaptation to lose about 2 mAP points on COCO by the end, with resets limiting the loss to under 0.5. It could fail if the drift detector fires on noise and discards useful adaptation.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Condition order and blend effects in continual adaptation of Grounding DINO
PROPOSAL: Examine forgetting and error accumulation when Grounding DINO with Swin-B is adapted over streams that move among clear, foggy, rainy, night and snowy Cityscapes conditions. All orderings of the five conditions are generated with three blend lengths, and adapters in the fusion layers are updated with pseudo-labels above 0.35 over 10000 images each. mAP is logged every 1000 images on probe sets and on COCO.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, resetting adapters when a drift detector fires, and unconstrained adaptation, with mAP curves averaged over orderings and a regression of final COCO loss on ordering features. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Expected the final COCO loss to depend mostly on stream length rather than ordering, with resets limiting loss to under 0.5 points. It could fail if a few orderings dominate the average of all runs.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Weak-strong augmentation consistency for online adaptation of vision-language detectors
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with Swin-T online with a teacher-student pair: the teacher, an exponential moving average of the student, labels a weakly augmented view, and the student is trained on a strongly augmented view of the same image using boxes above 0.4. Only layer norms and the final box head are updated. The stream is Cityscapes foggy followed by ACDC night, with batches of 8 and one pass.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, student-only self-training without the teacher, and consistency with weak augmentation on both views. Reported as mAP at 50 and by confirmation bias measured as the share of wrong pseudo-labels that the student repeats. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Expected 2 mAP points above student-only training and lower repetition of wrong pseudo-labels. It could fail if strong augmentation distorts fog patterns the detector relies on.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Augmentation strength and teacher momentum choices for Grounding DINO adaptation
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO with Swin-T online with a teacher-student pair: the teacher, an exponential moving average of the student, labels a weakly augmented view, and the student is trained on a strongly augmented view using boxes above 0.4. Only layer norms and the final box head are updated. Teacher momentum takes seven values, strong augmentation takes eight policies, and the stream is Cityscapes foggy then ACDC night, with batches of 8.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, student-only self-training without the teacher, and weak augmentation on both views, with mAP at 50 and repetition of wrong pseudo-labels tabulated per momentum and policy. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Expected most momenta above 0.99 to behave alike and 2 mAP points above student-only training. It could fail if a single augmentation policy accounts for the whole gain in practice.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Update frequency versus accuracy for real-time adaptation of vision-language detectors
PROPOSAL: Measure how often Grounding DINO with Swin-T must be updated to keep adaptation useful at video rate. Adapters in the fusion layers are updated every 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 frames on BDD100K night video of 200 sequences and Cityscapes foggy sequences of 100 clips, while inference runs on every frame. Report mAP at 50, frames per second on an A100 and the lag between a shift and recovery of accuracy.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, offline fine-tuning of the same adapters on the full target set as an upper reference, and updates scheduled by detector uncertainty. Reported with a trade-off curve of mAP against throughput. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1800
PREDICTION: Expected updates every 4 frames to retain 80 percent of the gain from every-frame updates at twice the throughput. It could fail if shift recovery needs updates in bursts that fixed schedules miss.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adapter size and update schedule grid for video-rate adaptation of Grounding DINO
PROPOSAL: Measure how adapter size and update schedule affect video-rate adaptation of Grounding DINO with Swin-T. Fusion-layer adapters with 5 ranks are updated every 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 frames over 4 learning rates on BDD100K night video of 200 sequences and Cityscapes foggy sequences of 100 clips.  Report mAP at 50, frames per second on an A100 and recovery lag after a shift.
CONTROLS: No adaptation, offline fine-tuning of the same adapters on the full target set as an upper reference, and updates scheduled by detector uncertainty, with a trade-off plot of mAP against throughput. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 1800
PREDICTION: Expected updates every 4 frames to keep 80 percent of the every-frame gain at twice the throughput, with adapter rank mattering little. It could fail if learning rate drives the trade-off more than schedule.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Transfer of a test-time adaptation recipe among vision-language detectors
PROPOSAL: Check whether one test-time adaptation recipe, fusion-layer adapters trained with pseudo-labels above 0.35, carries over from Grounding DINO to GLIP-T and OWL-ViT detectors. Each detector is adapted on Cityscapes foggy, BDD100K night and ACDC rain in a single pass of batches of 8, with the adapter placed at the layer where each model joins text and image features.
CONTROLS: No adaptation for each detector, full-parameter self-training for each, and the recipe applied with the adapter placed at the wrong layer. Reported as mAP at 50 and by loss on COCO. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 420
PREDICTION: Expected the recipe to give 2 to 3 mAP points on all three detectors, with the wrong-layer placement giving less than half of that. It could fail if OWL-ViT's lack of early fusion leaves no suitable adapter site.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Adapter placement for vision-language detectors under test-time adaptation
PROPOSAL: Check where adapters should sit when adapting GLIP-T, OWL-ViT and Grounding DINO online with pseudo-labels above 0.35. Each detector receives adapters at eight candidate layers and three ranks, trained on Cityscapes foggy, BDD100K night and ACDC rain in a single pass of batches of 8, giving two hundred and sixteen adapted runs, each logged every 50 batches with its adapter norm.
CONTROLS: No adaptation for each detector and full-parameter self-training for each, with mAP at 50 and COCO loss shown per layer, rank and detector, plus the share of pseudo-labels kept by the confidence filter at each layer. Runs use 3 seeds.
COST: 420
PREDICTION: Expected placements near the text-image join to give 2 to 3 mAP points on all three detectors, with deeper layers giving less than half. It could fail if best placement differs by detector.
